comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item (along with three other Catalyst items) can be obtained by finding and defeating new NPCs in deck battle at the following sea zones:

San Francisco, Open Sea
The Gulf of Alaska
Alexander Archipelago, Open Sea (10366, 3005)

NPC Fleet/Name: Royal Frigate x4; "Emerging PiratesABCD"
Sail Color: Red-Blue-Green-Yellow
Deck Battle: 4 NPCs will appear randomly with Attribute(Fire/Water/Air/Earth)

Tip: It's advised to have Plunder skill and Oxford skill Rare Item Plunder to increase chances of obtaining Catalyst items.

Catalysts can be used to craft Ancient Aether Charm (Sml) -- the recipe is a bit complicated, so see its page for details.
